section.name: What is Scope?
section.p: Scope is an open source framework built around an extensible implementation of the Hierarchical Model-View-Controller (HMVC) design pattern.
Its design is view-agnostic, meaning that Scope is built around a set of core classes, and there are extensions working only for a particular type of view.

Currently, Scope supports Servlet, XML/XLST and Swing as its View medium for interacting with the user.
This presentation shows only Scope working with a Swing GUI, but most concepts can be applied in other environments.
